description: L2 planner: read pool/l2 of a finished l4 module, emit web/contracts and web/shared defs, then ask l1 via pool/l1. No LLM on entry.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Pipeline state lives on disk at l2/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json. The task record is orchestration, not truth.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run with pipeline.status awaitingStep naming that step. The task completes without failed.
Two entries, one path: a step created by L4 with prompt { moduleName, thread, file }, or @@agentPlannerL2 <lowerCamel> which takes the oldest pool/l2 message. Both write the same pipeline.json.
Reads only the module l4 and pool/l2. Never reads l1. Writes l2/{module}/, l2/{module}/pipeline/ and pool/l1.
Deterministic first. entry10 has no LLM. Later steps spend an LLM call only on judgment.

invocation.fromL4: step prompt JSON { moduleName, thread, file }
invocation.moduleRule: The module token is required and must be lowerCamel. The name is never inferred from prose.
invocation.l4Rule: The module l4 pipeline.json must be status complete. Otherwise the run is refused.
invocation.poolRule: No file in pool/l2 refuses with 'nothing pending for <mod> in pool/l2'.

steps.goal: Parse the hand invocation or the L4 step prompt, read the pool/l2 message, refuse if none or l4 is not complete, write the l2 pipeline.json with thread and round.
Cut workspaces from the l4 journeys. Declared here; implemented by a later spec.
Emit contract defs per workspace. Declared here; implemented by a later spec.
Emit shared defs the pages will need. Declared here; implemented by a later spec.
Write one pool/l1 message per BFF call, trace on the l2 pipeline, then delete the pool/l2 message. Declared here; implemented by a later spec.
